body.para: Purpose
Creates a table (DBF file) with the specified fields, using the SQL syntax of Visual FoxPro. CREATE DBF is a synonym for CREATE TABLE.
Syntax

CREATE TABLE | DBF <TableName> [NAME <LongTableName>] [FREE] [CODEPAGE = <nCodePage>]
( <FieldName> <FieldType> [(<nWidth> [, <nPrecision>])]
[NULL | NOT NULL] [CHECK <lExpression> [ERROR <cMessage>]]
[DEFAULT <eExpression>] [AUTOINC [NEXTVALUE <n1>] [STEP <n2>]]
[PRIMARY KEY | UNIQUE] [NOCPTRANS]
[, <FieldName2> ...] )
CREATE TABLE | DBF <TableName> [NAME <LongTableName>] [FREE] [CODEPAGE = <nCodePage>] FROM ARRAY <ArrayName>
Arguments
<TableName>The name of the table to create. The default extension is .DBF.
NAME <LongTableName>A long name for the table in the current database.
FREECreates a free table: the table is not added to the current database, even when a database is open.
CODEPAGE = <nCodePage>The code page for the new table.

<FieldName> <FieldType>The name and type of the field. Valid types include C (Character), N (Numeric), F (Float), I (Integer), B (Double), Y (Currency), D (Date), T (DateTime), L (Logical), M (Memo), G (General), W (Blob) and Q (Varbinary). The width and precision are only needed for the types that have a variable size (C, N and F).
NULL | NOT NULLAllows or disallows NULL values in the field.
CHECK, DEFAULTThe validation rule and default value of the field. These are stored in the database container and are only used when the table is part of a database.
AUTOINC [NEXTVALUE n1] [STEP n2]Makes the field an auto increment field. NEXTVALUE is the first value (default 1) and STEP is the increment (default 1).
FROM ARRAY <ArrayName>Creates the table with the structure that is described in an array. The array has the same layout as the array that is returned by AFields().
Remarks

After the table has been created it stays open in the current work area. When a database is open, then the table is added to the database, unless the FREE clause is used. Field names are limited to 10 characters in a free table. When two field names have the same first 10 characters then the names are made unique by replacing the last character(s) with a number.
The primary key, foreign key, REFERENCES and similar clauses are parsed but they are only used when the table is part of a database container.
NOT SUPPORTED AT THIS MOMENT: Creating a table with an AS SELECT clause.
Examples
CREATE TABLE Customers (Id I AUTOINC, Name C(40) NOT NULL, Birthday D NULL, Notes M)
See Also
ALTER TABLE, CREATE CURSOR, ADD TABLE, CREATE
